name: Alsin
desc:
**Alsin** is a Celestial, and a very prominent figure in the religion of the Justicar. He's supposed to be the judge of every Justicar's Path, after their life ends.

As The Justicar are taught to interpret The Path in their own way, nobody knows what they have to do in order to get **Alsin**'s approval. The only thing the Justicar can do after they finish their path is pray for Alsin to have mercy on them.
additional_info:
-   There might as well be no right path, which makes the Justicar's way of living a lie.
-   Every path may be the right path, which makes any Justicar's way of living the truth.
